row.name: Force Concealment
row.effect: You can hide your Force signature. Other Force-sensitives must win a Quick Contest of Sense vs. your Stealth to detect you.
row.baseSkill: Stealth (DX/Average) or a contested Sense roll

levels.name: Force Concealment
levels.description: The user masks their presence in the Force, making them difficult for other Force-sensitives to detect.
levels.baseSkill: Stealth (DX/Average) or a contested Sense roll
levels.effect: You can hide your Force signature. Other Force-sensitives must win a Quick Contest of Sense vs. your Stealth to detect you.

levels.name: Force Concealment
levels.description: The user masks their presence in the Force, making them difficult for other Force-sensitives to detect.
levels.baseSkill: Stealth (DX/Average) or a contested Sense roll
levels.effect: You impose a -2 penalty on any Sense roll to detect your presence. You can extend this concealment to one willing adjacent person.

levels.name: Force Concealment
levels.description: The user masks their presence in the Force, making them difficult for other Force-sensitives to detect.
levels.baseSkill: Stealth (DX/Average) or a contested Sense roll
levels.effect: You impose a -4 penalty on detection rolls. You can conceal a small group (up to 3 people) in a 2-yard radius.

levels.name: Force Concealment
levels.description: The user masks their presence in the Force, making them difficult for other Force-sensitives to detect.
levels.baseSkill: Stealth (DX/Average) or a contested Sense roll
levels.effect: You are completely invisible to Force senses unless you use an overt Force power. You can conceal a group of up to 5 people.
